## Added
- Dynamic colours: the app takes its accent colours from the cover of the song that is playing (web, Android, Windows and Linux). Can be turned off in the settings under "Look"
- Download page: a 3D room with turntable, record crate, CDs, speaker and plants, records change by going back into their sleeve and coming out of the next one
- Download page: colours follow the cover of the record that is playing, screenshots without window frames, better layout on phones

## Fixed
- Nothing

## Install
- **Update server (Proxmox node shell):** run the installer again, it updates the existing container: `bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Labtoso/Musik/main/deploy/proxmox.sh)"`
- **Update server (Debian / Ubuntu):** `musik-update`
- **Android:** install `Musik.apk`, enter the server address
- **Windows:** run `Musik.exe`, enter the server address
- **Linux:** `chmod +x Musik.AppImage && ./Musik.AppImage`
- **Server only:** `musik-server-linux-x64`, `musik-server-linux-arm64` or `musik-server-windows-x64.exe`
